name: io.github.remembra-ai/remembra
title: Remembra Relay
description: Cross-agent handoff: the next coding agent starts from the last one's facts, not a blank page.

environmentVariables.name: REMEMBRA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Remembra API key (dashboard: Settings > API keys)

environmentVariables.name: REMEMBRA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Remembra server URL: https://api.remembra.dev, or your self-hosted server

environmentVariables.name: REMEMBRA_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Name this agent signs its handoffs with, e.g. claude-code, codex, cursor
